name: Pristine Yeti Hide
summary: In Feralas, a hide from Rage Scar's yetis may catch Pratt McGrubben's eye. It is unusually thick and tough, and Pratt is looking to buy yeti hides.

sections.title: A Hide Out of the Ordinary
sections.body: Among the hides from Rage Scar's yetis, this one is unusually thick and sturdy. Pratt McGrubben wants to buy yeti hides at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas, so this hide may interest him.

sections.title: Pratt's Reaction
sections.body: Pratt is amazed by the hide and wonders if any yeti hide could be greater. He offers more than a single hide usually fetches, believing something special can be made from it.

faq.q: Who wants the Pristine Yeti Hide?
aliases: where do i bring the yeti hide
faq.answer: Pratt McGrubben is looking to buy yeti hides at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
Compared with hides from Rage Scar's yetis, this one is unusually thick and tough.

aliases: where to bring pristine yeti hide
faq.answer: Pratt McGrubben is at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
